messages.text: does it run new harlo firmware

It's a Harlo unit, so it runs Harlo OS, the same software as the B30. I can't confirm which firmware version the first H15 batch will ship with, so I won't guess on that. Is there a particular feature in the new firmware you need?

Are you positive? you need to look at the harlo lab youtube video from today, He verbally ripped his own machine saying it is broke and likely wont run harlo firmware. it was the most bizarre thing i ever saw. I had both the b30 and the dual in my cart but now cant pull the trigger after what i saw.
Handed to the team · Technical/product question I can't verify: I have no confirmed facts on H15 firm

No, I'm not positive, and I spoke too soon. I don't have confirmed facts on which firmware the H15 Dual runs, and I can't watch that video.

You shouldn't spend money until you know, so I've passed your exact question to the team. That covers whether the H15 Dual runs Harlo firmware and whether the B30 is affected at all. They're back tomorrow at 10am ET, and the answer will come to (email hidden)

What made you want both units together, the Dogecoin side of the H15?
yea, kinda. i was buying both to solo mine exclusively and i liked how i could split the pools. I wanted both script and sha Anyone who saw the video would have a hard time buying one.
Searched the catalog · Hammer DC02 scrypt dogecoin litecoin miner

That's fair, and I wouldn't push you to buy the H15 until you have that answer.

There's a way to get the same setup without relying on one dual machine: two separate units, one on SHA-256 and one on Scrypt, each pointed at its own solo pool. The B30 covers Bitcoin at 30 TH/s, twice the H15's 15 TH/s. For Doge/LTC, the Hammer DC08 does 480 MH/s at about 137 W for $539.

Want me to look at that pair for you?
im questioning the b30 now as well. Sorry. total shit show today.

No need to apologise. If you saw that video today, of course you'd hesitate.

The B30 is already part of the question I sent, so tomorrow's answer to (email hidden) will cover both units. Waiting for it before you buy makes sense.

If you'd rather go with something that isn't a Harlo, the Magic Miner 40T is our other pick for solo SHA-256. Want me to pull its numbers so you have them ready to compare?
Looking for more a bit more efficiency.
Read the magic miner 40t page
Read the bsb b30 page
Read the gekkoscience kbox 22 th s page
Searched the catalog · Magic Miner 40T Harlo B30 GekkoScience KBOX bitcoin miner

By the listed specs, the most efficient non-Harlo option for SHA-256 is the Magic Miner 40T in Eco mode: 30 TH/s at 450 W, about 15 J/TH. It's $799. Standard mode gives 40 TH/s at 650 W, about 16 J/TH.

On the Scrypt side, the DC08 is the more efficient Hammer. It gets 480 MH/s from 137 W, against the DC06's 330 MH/s at 105 W.

What do you pay per kWh? I'll work out what each one costs you to run.
what is magic miner efficiency in high mode?

Turbo mode is 50 TH/s at 850 W, about 17 J/TH. That makes it the least efficient of the three modes. The listing also marks Turbo as an overclock that voids the warranty.

For efficiency, Eco is best at about 15 J/TH, and Standard is about 16 J/TH at 40 TH/s.

Which matters more to you, raw hashrate for the solo shot or a lower power bill?
yes! all the above,

Then the Magic Miner 40T in Standard is the one for you. It runs 40 TH/s at about 16 J/TH, which puts the most hashrate on the solo shot at nearly Eco efficiency. If power gets tight, you can drop to Eco any time. At $799, it's the best price per TH we sell and it isn't a Harlo.

Pair it with the DC08 for Doge/LTC on its own pool. Want me to put both in a cart?
is there a reason why you dont carry the kboxes

We do carry GekkoScience. The K. is just out of stock right now because GekkoScience has no units left, and the KBeast is off sale because there's no deal in place with the manufacturer at the moment.

For efficiency, the KBOX's 22 TH/s at 330 W comes to about 15 J/TH. That's the same as the Magic Miner in Eco, and the Magic Miner does 30 TH/s there.

Want me to set up the Magic Miner and DC08 cart?
anymore?
Searched the catalog · GekkoScience KBOX KBuddy KBeast

Not right now. GekkoScience has no KBOX units left to sell, and I don't have a restock date, so I won't guess whether or when it comes back.

If you want something you can order now, the Magic Miner 40T gets you that same 15 J/TH in Eco with more hashrate. Want me to set up the cart?
